verdict.rationale: mise covers a narrow form of event-driven automation. `mise watch` reruns tasks when files change, and shell activation automatically switches tool versions and loads or unloads env vars when you enter or leave a project directory. There is no evidence of a general, user-defined rules or hooks system for arbitrary events. Missing for 10: user-definable event rules or hooks beyond file-watching, documentation of watch configuration depth, independent hands-on corroboration.
